entities.summary: Sam Carrick is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a centre for the Buffalo Sabres of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected by the Toronto Maple Leafs in the fifth round, 144th overall, in the 2010 NHL entry draft. He also previously played with the Anaheim Ducks, Edmonton Oilers, and New York Rangers.
